sql: with mine as (select distinct market_ticker from live_orders   where strategy='Emmsell10' and action='buy'   and status in ('filled','resting','open','pending','partially_filled')), latest as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.quantity_fp, p.quantity,   p.market_exposure, p.realized_pnl from positions p join mine m using (market_ticker)   order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc) select 'KILL' as kind, 'orders_after_standdown' as k, count(*)::text as v   from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10'   and created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 19:24:55+00' union all select 'KILL','realized_pnl_usd', coalesce(sum(realized_pnl),0)::text from latest union all select 'KILL','exposure_max_single', coalesce(max(market_exposure),0)::text from latest union all select 'KILL','exposure_total', coalesce(sum(market_exposure),0)::text from latest union all select 'KILL','settled_flat', count(*)::text from latest   where coalesce(abs(quantity_fp), abs(quantity), 0) <= 0.01 union all select 'POS', p.strategy, p.market_ticker   from paper_positions p where p.strategy in ('Gmmsell1','Gmmsell0')   and p.status='open' and p.opened_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 20:28:00+00'
